content.rendered:
Join us for a fun and informative Pre-K Open House at the locations listed below! Our program is open to all 4 and 5 year olds and includes full day and half day options! Come meet our amazing teachers, explore our engaging learning spaces, and learn more about our exciting Pre-K program.

  • When: January 14, Drop in anytime between 4:00 pm & 6:00 pm
  • Where: The Pre-K Classrooms at Ridges Elementary and Middleton Elementary
